description: List the organization's members: userId, name, email, role (owner = admin, manager, member, viewer) and whether they are responsible for orders/tickets. Use it to resolve userIds for set_org_defaults and list_activity's actorUserId, and to answer who is in the organization — refer to a member by their name, never by the userId, which is a machine handle. Note: members are login accounts; people items get assigned to are person records (search_resources).
name: list_members

members.description: Login accounts in the org — NOT person records (search_resources)

isYou.description: Present only for the key owner

userId.description: Member userId — the id add_team_member and the assignee defaults want

title: List members
